business_problem: Before the advent of AI, interior designers followed a manual and hands-on approach, starting with client consultations to understand requirements and developing initial concepts using sketches or 2D software. They would research and select materials, finishes, fabrics, and furnishings to match the client's style and budget, presenting ideas through physical mood boards or digital collages. To help clients visualize the final design, designers used 3D modeling software for detailed renderings, which facilitated feedback and revisions before final approval. However, this process was time-consuming and teams faced challenges such as communication issues, limited iteration, and difficulties in keeping up with emerging trends.

Faced with lengthy turnaround times, limited iteration opportunities, challenges in trend identification, and constraints on personalization, Oodles decided to bet on Microsoft Azure to turn imaginative concepts into visually stunning realities. At the same time, Oodles’ plan to increase the use of AI in its operations demanded a significant amount of server capacity.
Transitioning to Microsoft Azure aligns with the company’s mission to provide top-tier, customized solutions using state-of-the-art in-house technology while enhancing AI readiness.

Oodles is in the business of transforming Hong Kong’s interior design industry with the help of innovation. Oodles Smart, their all-in-one online showroom solution, harnesses advanced technology like AI and big data to help users better visualize design ideas and explore creative possibilities. The goal is to streamline the design process, making it easier for designers and homeowners to bring their vision to life efficiently and effectively.
